text: PARSER: a keyword or bool token, a `!` (not `!=`) or a `(` glued to a closing string quote is now the CS3-6 parse error, as a glued name already was: `"flag is "true" now"` no longer checks clean and prints a truncated string, and `"a"(1)` no longer checks clean and panics. A glued `{` stays legal. No interpreter or runtime path changes.
